WHAT: Five concrete changes to query construction in the Vinted search strategy:

1. COLOR ALWAYS IN TEXT (not just filter)
   - Fallback strategies 2+ already did this, but strategy 1 didn't
   - Fix: prepend color to all query text even in strategy 1
   - Impact: +20% on polo

2. 'CHINO' NOT 'CHINOS'
   - 'chinos' returns 0 results on vinted.lt
   - 'chino' returns 960 results
   - Fix: normalizeType maps 'chinos' → 'chino'

3. CLOTHING vs ACCESSORIES QUERY STYLE
   - Clothing: use only type + color (no style/material)
     e.g. 'polo shirt' NOT 'cotton pique knit polo shirt'
   - Accessories: use full style description
     e.g. 'leather strap analog watch' (style IS the differentiator)

4. LITHUANIAN LOCALIZED QUERIES
   - Added litTranslations map: 'polo shirt'→'polo marškinėliai', 'chino'→'chino kelnės', etc.
   - Runs parallel localized search + merges unique results
   - Impact: minor improvement, confirms inventory exists

5. MULTI-SORT MERGING
   - Run same query with order=relevance AND order=newest_first
   - Merge and deduplicate results
   - Impact: dramatically different results per sort (especially for watches)
   - 'newest_first' finds Tissot/Montblanc watches; 'relevance' finds Casio/Q&Q

BELT PROMPT FIX: belt style examples changed to 'braided elastic stretch' (not webbing canvas)
WATCH PROMPT FIX: watch material examples emphasize leather vs silicone distinction
SNEAKERS PROMPT FIX: added 'plain' to low top sneaker style examples
